scope: Every indexed person page assembled from people.json, family_people.json and family_groups.json
sourcePolicy: No unsupported personal fact may be invented to meet the word target. The expanded page may combine verified direct biography material, direct source passages mentioning the person, and clearly labelled source context from the same documented family/historical branch. Context is never presented as a personal event unless the source explicitly connects it to the person.
sparseEvidenceRule: When direct evidence is insufficient, the page must say so and use a separately labelled source-context section rather than fabricating personal detail.
provenance: 100% of reproduced source text must retain source/extract identifiers.
